A.name: Ground truth provenance
A.details: GT boxes and masks are loaded from ScanRefer annotations and ScanNet object membership/bounds, not generated by this model. The frozen predicted Mask extent is a coordinate reference, not evaluation truth. Native bbs uses parsed language-token maps; the model forward receives point/voxel/text/superpoint/detected-proposal inputs, not GT boxes, GT masks, matching indices or keep eligibility. Original ScanNet pickle/annotation bytes were not supplied locally for an independent dataset rebuild.

B.name: Normalization, denominator and thresholds
B.details: Reported Box accuracy is strict IoU > 0.25 / > 0.5, hits divided by 9508; each module holdout uses 6887. IoU uses intersection over union, never a model-output maximum. Softmax and predicted-support normalization are internal operations, not accuracy normalization. The native bbox filter is disabled. CPU float64 recomputation of all stored prior/reference/final candidates produced zero selected-threshold flips and zero all256 final-oracle mismatches.

E.name: Scope and claim ceiling
E.details: One fixed seed2027; two lambda configurations; 29778 fit expressions per arm, one pass/3723 updates; four evaluations of the same 9508 development expressions across 141 physical scenes. Four module-holdout evaluations cover 6887 expressions/106 physical scenes, and these originate in the official training split rather than an unseen-scene guarantee for author-pretrained weights. Training-row scene counts and all augmentation tensors cannot be independently enumerated from the supplied per-step log, which stores IDs rather than scene/tensor hashes. No Sr3D/Nr3D or cross-seed efficacy evidence is present. Multi-seed is not a requirement and is not requested.

F.name: Evaluation type
F.details: Formal and module-holdout Box/Mask metrics are real_gt. Candidate-oracle values are GT-based diagnostic coverage, not deployable top1 scores. The training keep target uses detached reference IoU against dataset GT; that does not turn the formal metric into a synthetic proxy. Stored Mask IoU was recounted, not regenerated from raw predicted masks and point-membership tensors.

training_responsibility.details: Native matching produces filtered-GT indices in proposal/last/earlier-layer order, so matches[1] is the actual final-layer assignment. Keep matches retain their own filtered GT; unmatched candidates require Query-mask AND fused-mask root IoU > .5 and exclude every matched Query. No Box-IoU cutoff in keep. The pre-existing extra_geometry term separately retains its Box IoU <= .5 gate; these are distinct terms. Keep averages once over each expression union then actual batch B. Source handles non-root matched targets, but all observed fit matches total one per expression; the M0 does not demonstrate a multiple-GT runtime case.
